fact: 1926年7月20日法郎崩溃：英镑兑法郎突破240法郎（1925年初约100法郎）；7月21日法兰西银行总裁莫罗警告爱丽舍宫国家处于技术性破产边缘，愤怒人群包围波旁宫，赫里欧短命内阁倒台。7月23日普恩加莱受命组成「国民联盟」（Union Nationale）政府，兼任总理与财政部长。

sources.title: Il y a un siècle, 1926: The Year of Great Breakups
sources.quote: The climax came on July 20, 1926: the Franc collapsed completely, with the British Pound crossing the critical threshold of 240 francs (up from 100 francs in early 1925). The following day, the Governor of the Banque de France, Émile Moreau, warned the Élysée that the state was on the verge of declaring technical bankruptcy. ... On July 23, 1926, Raymond Poincaré was called to form a government of « National Union » (Union Nationale).

sources.title: Federal Reserve Bank of San Francisco, The Lesson of Poincaré（1983-07-08）
sources.quote: On July 25, 1926, a new government was formed by M. Raymond Poincaré. Consistent with the nature of both the political and economic crises, he also assumed the position of minister of finance.

fact: 普恩加莱稳定计划迅速落地：大幅提高间接税（增收约115亿法郎）、设立自治的「债务偿还基金」（Caisse autonome d'amortissement）管理国防公债、8月10日凡尔赛两院联席会议把公债担保写入宪法。法郎随即企稳回升。11月承认公务员结社权，但维持罢工禁令。

sources.title: Il y a un siècle, 1926: The Year of Great Breakups
sources.quote: His stabilization plan was swift and uncompromising: A massive increase in indirect taxation to raise 11.5 billion francs in new revenue. The creation of an autonomous management fund (Caisse autonome d'amortissement) specifically designed to manage national defense bonds. The convocation of a joint session of Parliament (the Congress) at Versailles on August 10 to enshrine the public debt guarantee into the French Constitution. ... In November, banking on this newfound stability, Poincaré eased social tensions by formally recognizing the right of civil servants to unionize, while strictly maintaining the ban on their right to strike.

sources.title: Federal Reserve Bank of San Francisco, The Lesson of Poincaré
sources.quote: He increased the applicability of a business turnover tax, raised the luxury tax and increased import duties, while at the same time lowering the tax rate on the highest income brackets from 60 to 30 per cent. Poincaré also gave the Banque de France an additional element of power and autonomy. A law was passed defining "agreements" of the central bank with respect to treasury loans and the limits on note circulation.

fact: 法郎在1926年下半年急速回升：7月至12月从40.96法郎/美元升至25.33法郎/美元；此后1927—1932年大体维持在约25法郎/美元。1926年底为事实上（de facto）稳定，1928年6月才法定（de jure）稳定。普恩加莱还借入摩根与Lazard资金对做空法郎者实施「逼空」。

sources.title: Federal Reserve Bank of San Francisco, The Lesson of Poincaré
sources.quote: From July to December 1926, the franc rose from 40.96 to 25.33 Ffr/$ . The franc's return to stability was indeed incredible. It remained relatively constant at around 25 francs to the dollar from 1927 to 1932

sources.title: Hoover Institution, Do Enlarged Fiscal Deficits Cause Inflation: The Historical Record
sources.quote: He raised taxes, cut expenditures and was able to borrow dollars from JP Morgan and Lazards and use the funds to conduct a bear squeeze on speculators selling the franc short. This stabilized the franc, which was then pegged to gold at a greatly depreciated rate.

sources.title: Eichengreen, Fetters of Gold and Paper
sources.quote: France took the opportunity offered by this stability and stabilized the franc at the low level that had resulted from the inflation. It was this decision to restore the franc's gold standard parity, de facto in 1926 and de jure in 1928

fact: 1926年法国的战债谈判落定：4月29日梅隆—贝朗热协定把对美战债固定为约68.47亿美元、分62年偿还；7月12日卡约—丘吉尔协定处理对英债务。战债偿付压力是法国财政与汇价的长期变量。

sources.title: WIPI, 1926 in France
sources.quote: War Debts: The Mellon-Bérenger Agreement (April 29) fixed France's wartime debt to the United States at approximately $6.847 billion, repayable over 62 years. The Caillaux-Churchill Agreement (July 12) addressed French debt to Britain.

sources.title: Il y a un siècle, 1926: The Year of Great Breakups
sources.quote: On April 29, the Mellon-Bérenger Agreement fixed the repayment of France's wartime debt to the United States at $6.847 billion, structured over 62 years.

fact: 1926年4月法郎对美元已跌至3.29美分（3月5日为3.73美分），比利时法郎同步走弱；同年9月17日白里安与斯特雷泽曼在托里会晤，开启法德缓和，9月德国加入国联并任常任理事，12月10日两人共获诺贝尔和平奖——外资回流法国的政治前提在1926年下半年成型。

sources.title: Federal Reserve Bulletin, May 1926（FRASER）
sources.quote: Both French and Belgian francs declined to new low records. The French franc declined from 3.73 cents on March 5 to 3.29 cents on April 28.

sources.title: WIPI, 1926 in France
sources.quote: Diplomacy: On September 17, Aristide Briand met German Foreign Minister Gustav Stresemann at Thoiry near Geneva, initiating a Franco-German rapprochement. Germany was admitted to the League of Nations with a permanent seat in September. Briand and Stresemann were jointly awarded the Nobel Peace Prize on December 10, 1926.

fact: 普恩加莱政府的立法授权：议会授予其以法令采取单边财政行动的全权（financial decision making was temporarily removed from the political arena）；8月10日凡尔赛联席会议把公债担保写入宪法；11月承认公务员结社权但维持罢工禁令。对穿越者而言，1926年下半年的法国是「规则快速重写期」，合同与税务安排须紧盯法令变动。

sources.title: Eichengreen, Fetters of Gold and Paper
sources.quote: Parliament granted Poincaré full powers of decree to take unilateral financial action. In effect, financial decision making was temporarily removed from the political arena. To buttress the budgetary position, Poincaré imposed increased indirect taxes and spending reductions.

sources.title: WIPI, 1926 in France
sources.quote: In November, Poincaré recognized the right of civil servants to unionize while maintaining the ban on their right to strike.

fact: 1926年3月法国预算显示支出364.5亿法郎对收入320.7亿法郎的缺口；财政部长杜梅拟对咖啡、糖、酒等日用消费品加税，被众议院否决并引发内阁倒台。日用品税负是1926年政治斗争的焦点之一，物价与税负直接影响普通家庭预算。

sources.title: Il y a un siècle, 1926: The Year of Great Breakups
sources.quote: In the Chamber of Deputies, the treasury was running dry: in March, the passed budget showed a staggering deficit of 36.45 billion francs in expenditures against only 32.07 billion in revenue. Seeking to plug the gap, Minister of Finance Paul Doumer proposed a controversial tax hike on everyday consumer goods (coffee, sugar, alcohol). He was immediately outvoted, triggering yet another cabinet collapse.

fact: 1926年法德工业索赔与贸易的核心是煤焦：道威斯计划框架下德国向法意供应「赔款煤」（作为实物赔款），压低了国际煤价并冲击英国煤炭出口；法国以赔款与占领为杠杆获取德国工业品与煤焦的安排，是「对德煤焦索赔贸易」的政策基础。1926年法德缓和（9月托里会晤）后，此类实物索赔贸易逐步转向正常贸易谈判。

sources.title: The Independent, What happened the last time Britain downed tools in 1926?
sources.quote: Prices for the mineral had also fallen as a result of the Dawes Plan, which required Germany to provide France and Italy – two key markets – with free coal as part of their reparations.

fact: 1926年的巴黎商业气象：广告公司Publicis由马塞尔·布勒斯坦-布朗歇创办；米其林指南首次为餐厅授星；1926年人口普查录得法国人口约4074万，俄侨社区超过6.7万人。服务业与消费文化在法郎动荡中仍有增量。

sources.title: WIPI, 1926 in France
sources.quote: The 1926 national census recorded a French population of approximately 40,743,851 people and showed an increase in the Russian émigré community, which numbered over 67,000 people. ... The Guide Michelin first awarded stars to restaurants. The advertising agency Publicis was founded by Marcel Bleustein-Blanchet.
